root_idea.summary: The root conveys even alignment: things made level with one another or set side by side in a common row or position.
root_idea.development: From the idea of levelness and equal placement develop meanings for rows and formations, places where ranks are drawn up, aligned bodily movement, and several specialized uses involving things placed together.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized active-participle headword صَافٌّ.
Displayed as the verbal noun صَفٌّ.
صَوَافّ is a plural active-participle variant of صَافٌّ, used of camels set in a row.
صَافُّونَ is the masculine plural active participle of صَافٌّ.
Displayed under the normalized passive-participle headword مَصْفُوفٌ.

senses.definition: Standing or arranged in a row or in ranks.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of people, angels, and other beings or things placed in an orderly formation; صَوَافّ in the Qur'anic description of sacrificial camels denotes them set or standing in a row.

senses.definition: Holding or spreading the wings outstretched while flying, without flapping them.
senses.usage_conditions: A specialized description of birds in flight; the construction contrasts this wing-spreading with repeated wing-beating.

senses.definition: A row, rank, or line; the arranging or standing of people or things in such alignment.
senses.usage_conditions: The verbal noun can denote an orderly formation or the state of standing in ranks, including a company or military force drawn up side by side.

senses.definition: A place of assembly or prayer where people stand in rows.
senses.usage_conditions: Reported as an interpretation of صَفًّا in 20:64; the same passage is also interpreted adverbially as meaning that the people come standing in ranks.

senses.definition: Set or arranged in an orderly row or rows.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle describing objects placed side by side in an aligned arrangement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel, to set the forelegs evenly side by side when being milked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized usage describing the animal's stance during milking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To milk a she-camel into two or three vessels at one milking, combining the vessels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression refers to the abundance of milk or to the arrangement of the milking vessels.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut flesh into broad or thin strips or slices and lay it out for roasting or drying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The flesh may be placed on live coals, pebbles, or in the sun; the sources describe related cutting and cooking practices.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To fit a صُفَّة, or saddle appendage, to a horse or other riding animal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized, figurative usage concerning the equipment of a saddle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confront or fight an opposing group while drawn up in ranks.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction describes two sides extending themselves in formation against one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To have one's house porch or covered frontage directly facing another's.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression based on one صُفَّة being opposite another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect or assemble together in a row, rank, or line.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may describe people gathering in formation or gathering together at a water source.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To stand, become, or place oneself in a row, rank, or line.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived reciprocal or reflexive formation verb, including standing in several ranks.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To travel or become alone in a level, open tract of land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported reading varies between journeying and becoming solitary in the level tract.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pasture upon trees called صَفْصَاف.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verb associated with grazing on the tree known as ṣafṣāf.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cry or chirping sound of a sparrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as a verbal noun or simple noun in some dialectal usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pair of bowls set together, especially bowls filled at one milking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning is attributed to the vessels being placed together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A medicament used to whiten the teeth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A covered appurtenance of a house or building, such as a porch, portico, or sheltered vestibule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same term underlies the designation Ahl al-Ṣuffa for people housed in the covered area of the Prophet's mosque; related uses include a roofed shelter over or before a doorway.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The covering or fitted appendage of a horse or camel saddle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It is the part between or around the saddle's structural pieces, comparable to a saddle cushion or cover.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A long period of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative temporal usage in the expression 'we lived a ṣuffa of time.'

other_classical_meanings.definition: The quantity of grain that can be placed on the palm of the hand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A small measured quantity, contrasted in the cited expression with a morsel of food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A garment worn beneath a coat of mail in battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized item of military clothing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that fills several milking vessels at one milking or sets her forelegs evenly while being milked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with abundant milk and with the camel's aligned stance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Meat cut into strips or broad slices and then roasted, dried, or otherwise prepared in that form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported preparations include meat laid on coals, pebbles, or in the sun; the exact preparation varies among authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Ṣūfiyya, a designation associated with the people of the ṣuffa.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived designation rather than a direct physical meaning of صفّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bird, spreading its wings and holding them extended without flapping.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the bird-specific lexical use underlying the Quranic wing description, retained here only as the broader headword's classical branch.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A level, smooth, even, or barren tract of land; a desert or waterless plain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This lexical item is also explicitly discussed in connection with Qur'an 20:106, although no corresponding QAC form group is supplied in the packet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The ridge, brow, or ledge of a mountain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized topographical meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sparrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in one or more dialects.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A dish or serving of a food known as سِكْبَاجَة.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal variant is also reported; this meaning is separate from the feminine form of صَفْصَفٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small insect identified with the weevil called سِيسَك.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The word is explicitly described as adventitious to Arabic and associated with Persian naming.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A willow or willow-like tree, including the tree called خِلَاف.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The precise botanical identification varies by region and species.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A single willow or willow-like tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine singulative form of صَفْصَافٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A station or place where ranks are drawn up for war or battle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural is مَصَافٌّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose house porch or covered frontage faces another person's porch.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional relational expression derived from opposing or facing ṣuffas.

cautions: The interpretation of صَفًّا in 20:64 is reported both as standing in ranks and, by another interpretation, as a place of prayer or assembly.

The Qur'anic use of صَفْصَفٌ in 20:106 is explicitly discussed by the supplied lexical evidence, but the QAC form groups supplied for this packet do not include a corresponding صفصف lemma; it is therefore retained among the broader lexical meanings rather than assigned to a Quranic form.

The three active-participle QAC groups are presented under the normalized citation headword صَافٌّ; their distinct plural forms and Quranic constructions remain visible in the occurrence coverage and senses.
